parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name group whose name you want to modify. You can call the [DescribeDomainGroups ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0)operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The new name of the domain name group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

Default value: en.
